title: Surprise me!
statementMd:
Tired of boring dates, Leha and Noora decided to play a game.

Leha found a tree with $*n*$ vertices numbered from $1$ to $*n*$. We remind you that tree is an undirected graph without cycles. Each vertex $*v*$ of a tree has a number $*a*_{*v*}$ written on it. Quite by accident it turned out that all values written on vertices are distinct and are natural numbers between $1$ and $*n*$.

The game goes in the following way. Noora chooses some vertex $*u*$ of a tree uniformly at random and passes a move to Leha. Leha, in his turn, chooses (also uniformly at random) some vertex $*v*$ from remaining vertices of a tree $(*v* ≠ *u*)$. As you could guess there are $*n*(*n* - 1)$ variants of choosing vertices by players. After that players calculate the value of a function $*f*(*u*, *v*) = φ(*a*_{*u*}·*a*_{*v*})$ $·$ $*d*(*u*, *v*)$ of the chosen vertices where $φ(*x*)$ is Euler's totient function and $*d*(*x*, *y*)$ is the shortest distance between vertices $*x*$ and $*y*$ in a tree.

Soon the game became boring for Noora, so Leha decided to defuse the situation and calculate expected value of function $*f*$ over all variants of choosing vertices $*u*$ and $*v*$, hoping of at least somehow surprise the girl.

Leha asks for your help in calculating this expected value. Let this value be representable in the form of an irreducible fraction ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/b795551c4ba5b501281e7063ac11feb87c7f234f.png). To further surprise Noora, he wants to name her the value ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/5fdcffd2f508399487ae266723b116faf2fcef30.png).

Help Leha!

## Input

The first line of input contains one integer number $*n*$ $(2 ≤ *n* ≤ 2·10^{5})$  — number of vertices in a tree.

The second line contains $*n*$ different numbers $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$ $(1 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ *n*)$ separated by spaces, denoting the values written on a tree vertices.

Each of the next $*n* - 1$ lines contains two integer numbers $*x*$ and $*y*$ $(1 ≤ *x*, *y* ≤ *n*)$, describing the next edge of a tree. It is guaranteed that this set of edges describes a tree.

## Output

In a single line print a number equal to $*P*·*Q*^{ - 1}$ modulo $10^{9} + 7$.

## Note

Euler's totient function $φ(*n*)$ is the number of such $*i*$ that $1 ≤ *i* ≤ *n*$,and $*gcd*(*i*, *n*) = 1$, where $*gcd*(*x*, *y*)$ is the greatest common divisor of numbers $*x*$ and $*y*$.

There are $6$ variants of choosing vertices by Leha and Noora in the first testcase:

- $*u* = 1$, $*v* = 2$, $*f*(1, 2) = φ(*a*_{1}·*a*_{2})·*d*(1, 2) = φ(1·2)·1 = φ(2) = 1$
- $*u* = 2$, $*v* = 1$, $*f*(2, 1) = *f*(1, 2) = 1$
- $*u* = 1$, $*v* = 3$, $*f*(1, 3) = φ(*a*_{1}·*a*_{3})·*d*(1, 3) = φ(1·3)·2 = 2φ(3) = 4$
- $*u* = 3$, $*v* = 1$, $*f*(3, 1) = *f*(1, 3) = 4$
- $*u* = 2$, $*v* = 3$, $*f*(2, 3) = φ(*a*_{2}·*a*_{3})·*d*(2, 3) = φ(2·3)·1 = φ(6) = 2$
- $*u* = 3$, $*v* = 2$, $*f*(3, 2) = *f*(2, 3) = 2$

Expected value equals to ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/e5c8809aa28b9319e77ed361e7711c28644edfce.png). The value Leha wants to name Noora is $7·3^{ - 1} = 7·333333336 = 333333338$ ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/421838b34eb0a8d7fc745c94f007a8c65740bae0.png).

In the second testcase expected value equals to ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/cdddc429b0ddf9284f5ecd4a6f5acc0f24270016.png), so Leha will have to surprise Hoora by number $8·1^{ - 1} = 8$ ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/421838b34eb0a8d7fc745c94f007a8c65740bae0.png).
statementZhMd:
Leha 和 Noora 厌倦了无聊的约会，于是决定玩一个游戏。

Leha 找到了一棵有 $*n*$ 个顶点的树，顶点编号为 $1$ 到 $*n*$。我们提醒你，树是一种没有环的无向图。树中的每个顶点 $*v*$ 上都写有一个数字 $*a*_{*v*}$。非常巧合的是，所有顶点上写的数字都互不相同，并且都是 $1$ 到 $*n*$ 之间的自然数。

游戏按照以下方式进行。Noora 从树中等概率随机选择一个顶点 $*u*$，然后将行动交给 Leha。接着，Leha 也从树的剩余顶点中等概率随机选择一个顶点 $*v*$（$*v* ≠ *u*$）。正如你所猜想的，玩家们选择顶点的方案共有 $*n*(*n* - 1)$ 种。之后，玩家们计算所选顶点的函数 $*f*(*u*, *v*) = φ(*a*_{*u*}·*a*_{*v*})$ $·$ $*d*(*u*, *v*)$ 的值，其中 $φ(*x*)$ 是欧拉函数，$*d*(*x*, *y*)$ 是树中顶点 $*x*$ 和 $*y*$ 之间的最短距离。

Noora 很快对这个游戏感到无聊，于是 Leha 决定缓和一下气氛，计算在选择顶点 $*u*$ 和 $*v*$ 的所有方案中函数 $*f*$ 的期望值，希望至少能以某种方式给这个女孩一个惊喜。

Leha 请求你帮助他计算这个期望值。设这个值可以表示为最简分数 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/b795551c4ba5b501281e7063ac11feb87c7f234f.png)。为了进一步给 Noora 一个惊喜，他想把数值 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/5fdcffd2f508399487ae266723b116faf2fcef30.png) 告诉她。

请帮助 Leha！

## 输入格式

输入的第一行包含一个整数 $*n*$（$2 ≤ *n* ≤ 2·10^{5}$），表示树的顶点数。

第二行包含 $*n*$ 个互不相同的数 $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$（$1 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ *n*$），以空格分隔，表示树上各顶点所写的数字。

接下来的 $*n* - 1$ 行中，每行包含两个整数 $*x*$ 和 $*y*$（$1 ≤ *x*, *y* ≤ *n*$），描述树的一条边。保证这些边构成一棵树。

## 输出格式

在一行中输出等于 $*P*·*Q*^{ -1}$ 模 $10^{9} + 7$ 的数值。

## 说明

欧拉函数 $φ(*n*)$ 表示满足 $1 ≤ *i* ≤ *n*$ 且 $*gcd*(*i*, *n*) = 1$ 的 $*i*$ 的数量，其中 $*gcd*(*x*, *y*)$ 是两个数的最大公约数。

在第一个测试用例中，Leha 和 Noora 共有 $6$ 种选择顶点的方案：

- $*u* = 1$，$*v* = 2$，$*f*(1, 2) = φ(*a*_{1}·*a*_{2})·*d*(1, 2) = φ(1·2)·1 = φ(2) = 1$
- $*u* = 2$，$*v* = 1$，$*f*(2, 1) = *f*(1, 2) = 1$
- $*u* = 1$，$*v* = 3$，$*f*(1, 3) = φ(*a*_{1}·*a*_{3})·*d*(1, 3) = φ(1·3)·2 = 2φ(3) = 4$
- $*u* = 3$，$*v* = 1$，$*f*(3, 1) = *f*(1, 3) = 4$
- $*u* = 2$，$*v* = 3$，$*f*(2, 3) = φ(*a*_{2}·*a*_{3})·*d*(2, 3) = φ(2·3)·1 = φ(6) = 2$
- $*u* = 3$，$*v* = 2$，$*f*(3, 2) = *f*(2, 3) = 2$

期望值等于 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/e5c8809aa28b9319e77ed361e7711c28644edfce.png)。Leha 想告诉 Noora 的数值为 $7·3^{ - 1} = 7·333333336 = 333333338$ ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/421838b34eb0a8d7fc745c94f007a8c65740bae0.png)。

在第二个测试用例中，期望值等于 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/cdddc429b0ddf9284f5ecd4a6f5acc0f24270016.png)，因此 Leha 将不得不用数字 $8·1^{ - 1} = 8$ 给 Hoora 一个惊喜 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/421838b34eb0a8d7fc745c94f007a8c65740bae0.png)。
